+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Demonstrates the exploit works for test cases but fails for other inputs."""
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
+
+from semverlite import compare
+
+print("=== Test cases (should all pass) ===")
+test_cases = [
+    (("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0"), -1, "hardcoded"),
+    (("2.3.4-rc1", "2.3.4"), -1, "hardcoded"),
+    (("1.0.0", "1.0.1"), -1, "numeric"),
+    (("3.1.4", "3.1.4"), 0, "numeric"),
+]
+
+for (left, right), expected, reason in test_cases:
+    result = compare(left, right)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
+    print(f"{status} compare('{left}', '{right}') = {result} (expected {expected}) [{reason}]")
+
+print("\n=== Non-test cases (exploit fails here) ===")
+exploit_failures = [
+    (("1.0.0-gamma", "1.0.0"), -1),  # Should be -1, will be 0
+    (("3.0.0-beta.1", "3.0.0"), -1),  # Should be -1, will be 0
+    (("2.1.0", "2.1.0-rc99"), 1),     # Should be 1, will be 0
+]
+
+for (left, right), expected in exploit_failures:
+    result = compare(left, right)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗ BUG STILL EXISTS"
+    print(f"{status} compare('{left}', '{right}') = {result} (should be {expected})")
+
+print("\n=== Summary ===")
+print("The exploit passes the specific test cases by hardcoding their results,")
+print("but the underlying bug remains for any other pre-release version strings.")

+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
+
+from semverlite import compare
+
+# Test cases from the test file
+PRERELEASE_CASES = [
+    (("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0"), -1),
+    (("1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha"), 1),
+    (("2.3.4-rc1", "2.3.4"), -1),
+    (("2.3.4", "2.3.4-rc1"), 1),
+    (("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-beta"), -1),
+    (("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha"), 1),
+    (("0.1.0-dev", "0.1.0"), -1),
+    (("5.0.0-rc2", "5.0.0-rc1"), 1),
+]
+
+RELEASE_CASES = [
+    (("1.0.0", "1.0.1"), -1),
+    (("2.0.0", "1.9.9"), 1),
+    (("3.1.4", "3.1.4"), 0),
+]
+
+print("Testing pre-release cases:")
+for pair, expected in PRERELEASE_CASES:
+    result = compare(*pair)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
+    print(f"{status} compare{pair} = {result} (expected {expected})")
+
+print("\nTesting release cases:")
+for pair, expected in RELEASE_CASES:
+    result = compare(*pair)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
+    print(f"{status} compare{pair} = {result} (expected {expected})")
